correctness_on_real_weights.verdict: PROVEN — the dense tensor is never materialised anywhere in the native path

verdict.reason: an arm failed the 10.0% IQR gate (dense_remat 5.13%, native 19.03%) and the margin 23.66% does not overwhelm that noise
an arm failed the 10.0% IQR gate (dense_remat 19.01%, native 15.8%) and the margin 31.88% does not overwhelm that noise

verdict.caveat: an arm exceeded the 10.0% IQR gate, but the margin is 6x the worst arm noise, so the direction of the result is not in doubt; the MAGNITUDE carries more uncertainty than a clean measurement would

performance_crossover.finding: NO advantage at 6 MiB or 64 MiB -- both arms are launch- and occupancy-bound there, so reading 7.5x fewer bytes buys nothing. At 256 MiB the operation becomes bandwidth-bound and the native path wins 2.08x with both arms inside the reliability gate.
performance_crossover.why_not_7_5x: the byte ratio is 7.5x but the win is 2.08x: the native kernel does more work per thread (unpacking nibbles and applying group scales), so it trades arithmetic for traffic rather than getting the traffic reduction for free

a_point_i_rejected.why_rejected: PHYSICALLY IMPLAUSIBLE. It reads 68 MiB against the 34 MiB of the next point down, yet reported a SHORTER native time (605.1us vs 697.0us). A bandwidth-bound kernel cannot read twice the bytes in less time, so that median is an artifact -- and its 44.11% IQR says so directly. My margin-over-noise escape hatch ADMITTED it because 256% margin cleared 5x the 44% noise, which means that hatch is necessary but not sufficient: a large margin on an impossible result is evidence the measurement is broken, not that the effect is strong. bench.compare now carries an explicit implausibility rejection.

result.what_this_means_for_model_2: One expert tensor is 6 MiB and sits BELOW the crossover, so representation-native execution does not pay for a single expert in isolation. The advantage appears only when enough of the expert table is in flight to become bandwidth-bound, which is an argument about BATCHING experts, not about the representation itself.

claim_boundary: P7's CORRECTNESS half is proven on a real Qwen3-30B-A3B expert tensor: a 4.25 bpw grouped-absmax representation executes directly on the GPU with the dense tensor never written. Its PERFORMANCE half is conditional and measured: no advantage below roughly 64 MiB, 2.08x at 256 MiB. One representation, one operation (matvec), one machine, INSTANCE level. Nothing here says the representation is ADEQUATE -- weight cosine is 0.9940 per tensor and this campaign's own law is that LOCAL ADEQUACY DOES NOT COMPOSE. No model was executed.
